expectedOutcome: User can see a concrete execution document that narrows the work to Authority session identity lifecycle plus receipt-backed gate consumption, while clearly separating Python Authority Server, runner host, Lattice CLI, and cross-repo validation responsibilities.
actualTranscript: npm run build completed successfully via packages/main tsc. lattice validate --story=B-c5fe passed, including npm test, story-lifecycle, gap-convergence, ALL PASS, and verification intent coverage 3/3 covered. Delivery reviewer signed delivery-check.json with 1 verified docsPromise and 2 real-machine test records.
outcomeDiff: Expected a detailed document without overclaiming session ID readiness or fake/local receipts as strong evidence; actual document exists at docs/requirements/decisions/authority-session-receipt-gate-execution.md and explicitly says KOALA_AUTHORITY_SESSION_ID is presence detection only, strongEvidenceConsumed is derived from verified receipt refs consumed by gate predicates, and real implementation remains split into future stories.

pitfalls: Do not treat sessionConfigured, transport accepted, fake server receipts, local diagnostics, or report prose as productionDone/receiptVerified/strongEvidenceConsumed; future implementation must fail closed until a real AuthorityReceipt is verified and consumed by the gate.
